nodes.label: Behavior-First Fingerprinting
nodes.rationale: Names, ordering in UI, and cosmetic properties change frequently and are not reliable signals of functional intent. Behavioral properties are the only stable basis for standards governance and drift detection.

nodes.label: Deterministic, Auditable Hashes
nodes.rationale: Hashes without explainability cannot be trusted or debugged. Auditability is mandatory for governance and standards enforcement.

nodes.label: record_rows as Canonical Explainability
nodes.rationale: Lists of names or counts are insufficient for traceability. A stable (record_key → sig_hash) mapping enables diffs, audits, and downstream tooling.

nodes.label: UniqueId Usage Is Restricted
nodes.rationale: Blind use of UniqueId causes unnecessary churn and false drift. Some domains are definition-based, not identity-based.

nodes.label: Fail-Soft Is Mandatory
nodes.rationale: Silence hides risk. Explicit failure markers preserve state distinctions and auditability.

nodes.label: Ordering Rules Are Explicit Per Domain
nodes.rationale: Some structures (e.g. view filter stacks) are order-dependent; others are not. Implicit ordering leads to accidental semantic changes.

nodes.label: Global vs Contextual Domain Split
nodes.rationale: Duplication of global definitions inside views/templates causes inconsistency and waste.

nodes.label: View Templates Are Behavioral, Not Nominal
nodes.rationale: Two templates with the same name can behave differently. Name-only fingerprints are misleading and unsafe.

nodes.label: Views Compose Templates + Deltas
nodes.rationale: This mirrors actual Revit behavior and avoids double-counting settings.

nodes.label: Phase Names in Behavioral Hashes
nodes.rationale: UniqueIds are document-specific and cannot be compared across projects. Phase names provide the semantic link needed for cross-project drift detection.

nodes.label: Domain-Driven Architecture
nodes.rationale: This enables refactoring, selective execution, and future portability.

nodes.label: Markdown Portability Rule
nodes.rationale: GitHub Mobile, Obsidian, and chat renderers handle nested fences inconsistently.

nodes.label: Phase Graphics Domain Disabled (API Limitation)
nodes.rationale: Avoids misleading fingerprints and false confidence.

nodes.label: Hash Mode Migration Timeline
nodes.rationale: Setting explicit criteria prevents indefinite deferral while protecting against premature switching.

nodes.label: Domain Family Split Architecture
nodes.rationale: Monolithic extractors mixed heterogeneous record structures, making per-class policy governance impractical.

nodes.label: View Category Overrides Scope and Category Classification
nodes.rationale: This reflects current data coverage, not completed cross-region standardization.

nodes.label: line_patterns Join Key Upgraded to Scale-Invariant Normalized Segments
nodes.rationale: Governance identity for line patterns is structural type, not absolute scale.

nodes.label: loaded_family_types scope: loaded families only; system families deferred
nodes.rationale: A dedicated system_family_types domain (or expansion of compound_types) to cover the remaining system families is deferred until Phase-1 analysis establishes which categories are worth the extraction investment.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 1: manifest/health/evidence-map)
nodes.rationale: This is a legibility aid, not a source of truth.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 2: structured findings)
nodes.rationale: A finding's support[].artifact_id always resolves to a real artifact.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 3: policy externalization)
nodes.rationale: A governance threshold, excluded/passive-inheritance-risk domain set, or guidance sentence can now be changed by editing JSON without a code change.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 4: interpretation guide, question routes, governance brief)
nodes.rationale: This is a legibility aid, not a source of truth.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 5: live file-availability inventory)
nodes.rationale: This phase is the first to close that gap for files this generator does not itself consume.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 6: escalation-target file coverage)
nodes.rationale: This phase only adds evidence-map metadata (context_role, can_answer/cannot_answer, columns, row_count) for files this generator already declared it never reads.

nodes.label: identity domain expansion: project_info.* fields, included in sig_hash
nodes.rationale: This creates real tension with this project's own non-negotiable rule.

nodes.label: Backfill: segment lattice is a dimensional powerset, not a single-parent tree
nodes.rationale: This architecture underlies every downstream segment/governance tool.

nodes.label: structural_ancestor and population_containment: two independent lineage relations for comparison-discovery validity
nodes.rationale: Lineage/containment is split into two explicitly separate, independently-computed relations.

nodes.label: ancestor_segment_ids serialization fix: ; joined, not | joined
nodes.rationale: There is no migration path for old values, because they were never losslessly parseable in the first place.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 6: anomaly/note threshold externalization + classification-logic legibility)
nodes.rationale: A threshold in detect_anomalies(), the phases check, build_governance_state_summary()'s primary-read selection, or _passive_inheritance_risk_domains() can now be changed via JSON without a code change.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 7: reading-order artifact and completeness gate)
nodes.rationale: This is a convention, not an enforcement mechanism.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 8: insufficient-evidence and single-region known-bad-inference clarifications)
nodes.rationale: The next corpus expansion that adds a second business center's Project-role files or a second region should prompt revisiting whether these two known-bad-inference entries are still accurate as written.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 9a: comparison-registry input-completeness note)
nodes.rationale: This is explicitly a narrower, faster fix than the 'dedicated aggregate/distribution reporter'.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 9b: union-inventory-derived domain confidence enrichment)
nodes.rationale: This closes the last open item in docs/governance_generator_cross_compare_coverage.md's implementation sequence.

nodes.label: Governance narrative evidence-package layer (Phase 10: static-doc subfolder + self-contained package copy)
nodes.rationale: A --out directory is now self-contained: a reader with only that directory can open the four static reference docs.

nodes.label: Join-policy gate exemption for single-record-per-file domains (units_doc, worksets_doc)
nodes.rationale: This decision is the record of why it exists and why it shouldn't become the permanent answer.

nodes.label: Enterprise artifact provenance and promotion schema v2
nodes.rationale: Classification uses the effective policy label, never the enterprise BC bookkeeping token alone.

nodes.label: Consolidated name-projection and extractor rationale
nodes.rationale: Historical audits 6–15 record how these conclusions were reached, but are not part of the contract.
